meaning: Too much greed leads to trouble.
english: Grasp all, lose all.
example: Seeing his brother risk all his monthly earnings on an unverified lottery scheme after already winning a decent payout, Anand warned him, 'Ati aase gati kedu; don't ruin yourself chasing impossible greed.'

meaning: Hard work brings rewards.
english: No pain, no gain.
example: After working sixteen hours a day in the sun building his small furniture workshop, Basavaraj happily served sweets to his family, reminding them that kai kesaradare baayi mosaru.

meaning: You reap what you sow.
english: As you sow, so you reap.
example: When the supervisor was caught secretly shifting his own accounting blunders onto the apprentice, the director fired him immediately, saying that in the end, maadiddunno maharaya.

meaning: Habits are easier to correct early.
english: As the twig is bent, so the tree is inclined.
example: Observing her nephew throw violent tantrums whenever denied toys, Suma advised his mother, 'Gidavaagi baggaddu maravaagi baggeethe? Discipline him gently now while his character is still forming.'

meaning: Small efforts add up.
english: Many a little makes a mickle.
example: By setting aside just fifty rupees each day in a small ceramic jar, the college student bought his semester textbooks without asking his parents, demonstrating hani hani koodi halla.

meaning: Patience helps a person endure and succeed.
english: He who endures conquers.
example: Despite enduring months of project delays and client criticism without losing his temper, the architect finally won the state contract, proving that thaalidavanu baaliyaanu.

meaning: Live within your means.
english: Cut your coat according to your cloth.
example: When his colleagues took out expensive car loans to show off in the office, Chandrashekhar chose a modest scooter, advising them to always cut their coat according to their cloth.

meaning: Haste can cause mistakes.
english: Haste makes waste.
example: In his impatience to overtake three lorries on a wet hairpin curve, the cab driver skidded into a ditch, illustrating that avasarave apaghaatakke kaarana.

meaning: You get results according to what you sow.
english: You reap what you sow.
example: Having devoted hours every weekend to mentoring underprivileged kids, Raghav was delighted when the community honored his selfless work, knowing that as you sow, so you reap.

meaning: Time waits for no one.
english: Time and tide wait for no man.
example: While his competitors spent three months deliberating on contract fine print, the swift entrepreneur launched the mobile app, remarking that time and tide wait for no man.

meaning: Lost time never returns.
english: Lost time is never found again.
example: Reflecting on his lost college years spent loafing instead of studying for competitive exams, Ramesh sighed, 'Hoda kaala matte baaradu; lost hours never come back.'

meaning: Adapt to the situation.
english: When in Rome, do as the Romans do.
example: During the formal village council assembly, the young urban researcher dressed respectfully in a traditional dhoti and folded his hands, following the wisdom of kaalakke thakka kola.

meaning: There are no rewards without effort.
english: No sweet without sweat.
example: Seeing her exhausted son ready to give up after failing his medical mock test, the mother placed a glass of milk before him and said, 'Kashtavillade phalavilla; sweet results require sweat.'

meaning: Work is sacred.
english: Work is worship.
example: Even after retiring as a chief engineer, Gowda cleaned his own tool shed and fixed neighborhood water pumps with pride, firmly believing that kelasave kailaasa.

meaning: Actions matter more than words.
english: Actions speak louder than words.
example: Instead of delivering another passionate speech about cleaning the temple premises, the youth leader picked up a broom and began sweeping, proving that maathigintha kruti melu.

meaning: Do not put off today's work.
english: Never put off till tomorrow what you can do today.
example: When her sister suggested filing their income tax returns on the final due date, Deepa sat at the laptop immediately, insisting, 'Never postpone a day's work to tomorrow.'

meaning: Doing nothing will not solve your problems.
english: Deep rivers move with silent majesty.
example: His uncle scolded the idle youth sitting under the banyan tree waiting for government grants, stating bluntly, 'Folded hands and sitting idle will never feed an empty stomach.'

meaning: Effort can bring results.
english: Diligence is the mother of good fortune.
example: Though the soil was rocky and irrigation scarce, the persistent farmer dug three trenches and planted millets, confident that genuine effort always yields its rightful reward.

meaning: A determined person finds a way.
english: Where there is a will, there is a way.
example: When heavy landslides blocked the main highway to the district hospital, the determined ambulance driver navigated an unpaved forest trail, showing that guri iddavange daari siguttade.

meaning: Comfort often follows hardship.
english: After rain comes sunshine.
example: Surviving three devastating drought seasons before harvesting bumper sugarcane this autumn reminded the farming family that sweet comfort always follows bitter hardship.

meaning: A good beginning makes work easier.
english: Strike while the iron is hot.
example: By preparing a flawless, detailed blueprint on day one, the engineering squad completed the rural bridge two weeks ahead of schedule, proving that a good beginning is half the task.

meaning: Timely work is worthwhile.
english: Timely work is worthwhile.
example: Spraying pesticide at the exact moment the insect larvae emerged saved the grape harvest, confirming that work done at the proper hour alone is truly fruitful.

meaning: Preparation after trouble begins is too late.
english: Preparation after trouble begins is too late.
example: The storekeeper scrambled to buy flood barriers only after muddy rainwater rushed through his cellar door, prompting neighbors to remark on opening an umbrella after the storm.

meaning: Arriving after everything is over is useless.
english: Locking the stable door after the horse has bolted.
example: When the municipal water tanker finally arrived four hours after the kitchen fire had already burnt the hut to ashes, villagers scoffed that Hanumappa arrived after the town burned.

gaade: ಒಲೆ ಹತ್ತಿ ಉರಿದ ಮೇಲೆ ಅಡುಗೆ ನೆನಪಾದಂತೆ.
meaning: Remembering only after it is too late.
english: Remembering only after it is too late.
example: Forgetting to buy salt until the sambar was already boiling over the woodfire made everyone laugh at remembering cooking only after the stove is ablaze.

meaning: Do not repeat a mistake you already know about.
english: Once bitten, twice shy.
example: Having already lost his security deposit to a fake housing broker last year, Naveen refused to wire any cash without a signed deed, refusing to fall into a day-seen well at night.

meaning: Do not waste an opportunity.
english: Do not waste an opportunity.
example: When offered a sponsored scholarship to study abroad, Swathi signed the agreement on the same afternoon, knowing one must never let go of an opportunity that lands in one's hands.

meaning: Face the situation that comes.
english: Face the situation that comes.
example: Standing firm before the unexpected audit committee without panic or trembling, the bank manager handled every tough query with composure, prepared to face whatever comes.

meaning: A truly knowledgeable person is humble.
english: Empty vessels make the most noise.
example: Unlike the junior associate who boasted loudly at the cafeteria table, the senior scientist listened quietly and answered only when asked, behaving like a full pot that never spills.

meaning: The more accomplished a person is the more humble they can be.
english: The more accomplished a person is the more humble they can be.
example: The renowned classical singer bowed deeply to touch the feet of his elderly guru before accepting his national medal, exemplifying the tree that bends lower as its fruit ripens.

meaning: Over cleverness can backfire.
english: Over cleverness can backfire.
example: By trying to outsmart the income tax department with three layers of fabricated shell invoices, the greedy merchant landed in prison, undone by his own over-cleverness.

meaning: Things look better from a distance.
english: The grass is always greener on the other side.
example: Disillusioned by the relentless traffic and solitary cubicle life in the metropolis, Karthik recalled his father's words: 'Distant mountains always appear deceptively smooth to the eye.'

meaning: Everyone gets their moment eventually.
english: Every dog has its day.
example: After being sidelined on the sports bench for three years, the substitute striker scored the tournament-winning goal, proving that when the right moment arrives, even stones will speak.

meaning: A person's immediate need matters most.
english: A person's immediate need matters most.
example: To the stranded trekker lost in the Western Ghats for thirty hours, a simple packet of cold beaten rice offered by a villager tasted like a feast from heaven.

meaning: Be content with what you have.
english: Be content with what you have.
example: Living happily in a small tiled roof cottage without chasing flashy cars or status symbols, the elderly postman enjoyed profound inner peace, content with whatever he possessed.

meaning: Desires should have limits.
english: Moderation in all things.
example: Warned by his accountant that expanding to four new cities on borrowed capital was reckless, the founder hesitated, recognizing that ambitious desire must respect realistic limits.

meaning: Honest work is sacred.
english: Honest work is sacred.
example: Whether sweeping the courtyard at sunrise or bookkeeping late into the night, the honest artisan poured devotion into every stroke, honoring work as sacred worship.

meaning: Do not reject the support that helped you rise.
english: Do not reject the support that helped you rise.
example: Once elected town councillor, the young politician immediately stopped answering calls from the volunteers who had campaigned for him, shamelessly kicking away the ladder he climbed.

meaning: Hard work can bring results.
english: Hard work can bring results.
example: Blistered hands and sleepless nights spent practicing coding problems paid off when Sheela received her offer letter, proving that enduring hardship brings its reward.

meaning: One must adapt to changing times.
english: One must adapt to changing times.
example: Realizing that customers now preferred digital payments over cash, the traditional provision merchant installed a QR scanner, adapting wisely to changing times.

meaning: Focus on one task at a time.
english: Focus on one task at a time.
example: When his nephew tried to prepare for entrance exams while simultaneously running an online gaming channel, his uncle insisted on completing one task for one time.

meaning: Patience can prevent trouble.
english: Patience is a plaster for all sores.
example: Instead of trading insults with the aggressive driver who dented his bumper, Madhav quietly took photos and contacted the insurer, showing that patience prevents greater turmoil.

meaning: Good actions bring good outcomes.
english: Good actions bring good outcomes.
example: Consistently supplying fresh, unadulterated milk to the colony earned the dairy farmer generations of loyal patrons, demonstrating that righteous deeds bring sweet outcomes.

meaning: Effort produces results.
english: Effort produces results.
example: Watching the golden paddy fields sway gently in the breeze, the proud farmer told his sons that only sweat poured into the soil brings rich harvests.

gaade: ಕೈಗೆ ಸಿಕ್ಕಾಗ ಕಾಯಿ, ಬಾಯಿಗೆ ಸಿಕ್ಕಾಗ ಹಣ್ಣು.
meaning: Value something while it is available.
english: Look before you leap.
example: Appreciate the fresh coconut water while the tree is bearing fruit right before your eyes; value blessings when they are within reach.

meaning: Time and circumstances are powerful.
english: Time and circumstances are powerful.
example: Seeing mighty emperors and wealthy dynasties fade into obscure history reminds us all to bow humbly before the inexorable power of time.

meaning: Laziness can lead to hardship.
english: Laziness can lead to hardship.
example: Wasting his prime youth sleeping until noon and refusing apprentice jobs, the idle lad soon found his pantry empty, confirming that sloth is the root of destitution.

meaning: Work and responsibility are important qualities.
english: Work and responsibility are important qualities.
example: Stepping forward to support his sick father's household without complaint, the young man demonstrated that honest labor and duty are the true marks of dignity.

meaning: Unity is strength.
english: Unity is strength.
example: By uniting all sixty families in the hamlet to build a check-dam before monsoon, the villagers prevented drought, proving that strength lies in unbroken unity.

gaade: ಹತ್ತು ಜನ ಸೇರಿ ಮಾಡಿದ ಕೆಲಸ ಹಗುರ.
meaning: Teamwork makes difficult work easier.
english: Many hands make light work.
example: Lifting the heavy collapsed roof beam became simple when ten neighbors grabbed hold together, confirming that work shared among ten people becomes light as a feather.

meaning: A true relative is one who helps in trouble.
english: A friend in need is a friend indeed.
example: While fair-weather acquaintances vanished the moment his shop caught fire, the quiet neighbor arrived with dry provisions and shelter, proving that a true relative is one who stands by in disaster.

meaning: A real friend stands by you in difficult times.
english: A real friend stands by you in difficult times.
example: When everyone else distanced themselves after his bankruptcy, Srinivas remained by his side and helped him draft a recovery plan, showing that a real friend arrives in dark times.

meaning: A conflict often involves more than one side.
english: It takes two to tango.
example: In mediating the dispute between the two brothers, the elder pointed out that an argument never sustains itself without both sides clapping.

meaning: Silence can be more valuable than speech.
english: Silence can be more valuable than speech.
example: Refraining from answering the provocative political taunt at the dinner table, Shridhar enjoyed a serene evening, realizing that while speech is silver, silence is pure gold.

meaning: Everyone thinks their own is the best.
english: Everyone thinks their own is the best.
example: Though her puppy was muddy and had torn ears, the little girl hugged it fiercely and proclaimed it the prettiest pet in the district, just as every crow loves its chick.

gaade: ಹಲ್ಲಿದ್ದಾಗ ಕಡಲೆ ಇಲ್ಲ, ಕಡಲೆ ಇದ್ದಾಗ ಹಲ್ಲಿಲ್ಲ.
meaning: Opportunity and ability do not always arrive together.
english: Opportunity and ability do not always arrive together.
example: Now that the retired clerk finally had the money to tour snow-capped Himalayan peaks, his failing knees kept him indoors, illustrating having teeth without nuts and nuts without teeth.

meaning: Everyone has their own worries.
english: Everyone has their own worries.
example: Looking around the crowded train compartment, the commuter realized that beneath polite smiles, every single person carried their own private weight of worries.

meaning: Everyone faces the consequences of their actions.
english: Everyone faces the consequences of their actions.
example: Seeing the corrupt municipal contractor finally arrested for tax fraud, the townsfolk shook their heads, knowing that in the cosmic order, each soul reaps its own karma.

gaade: ಮಾತು ಆಡಿದರೆ ಹೋಯಿತು, ಮುತ್ತು ಒಡೆದರೆ ಹೋಯಿತು.
meaning: Spoken words cannot be taken back.
english: A word spoken is an arrow shot.
example: Once the cruel rumor slipped from her tongue in the tea party, no tearful apology could undo the heartbreak it caused, just like a shattered pearl that cannot be remade.

meaning: Some habits are difficult to change.
english: Some habits are difficult to change.
example: Despite three corporate ethics workshops, the dishonest cashier was caught skimming five-rupee coins again, proving that a dog's tail remains hopelessly bent.

meaning: We often fail to value what is close to us.
english: We often fail to value what is close to us.
example: Ignoring the fresh medicinal neem leaves growing in her backyard, Lakshmi bought expensive branded herbal pills from the pharmacy, forgetting that the backyard plant is never valued as medicine.

meaning: People in one household may have different opinions.
english: People in one household may have different opinions.
example: With the father wanting to sell the farmland, the mother wanting to lease it, and the son wanting to build a warehouse, their household became a house with three conflicting doors.

meaning: Not everyone is alike.
english: Not everyone is alike.
example: Accepting that his elder child excelled in music while the younger loved wrestling, the father smiled, knowing that all fruits grown on the same branch do not share identical sweetness.

gaade: ಕುಂಬಳಕಾಯಿ ಕಳ್ಳ ಅಂದರೆ ಹೆಗಲು ಮುಟ್ಟಿ ನೋಡಿಕೊಂಡ.
meaning: A guilty person becomes defensive when accused.
english: A guilty conscience needs no accuser.
example: The moment the hostel warden mentioned that someone had snuck into the pantry, the guilty boy involuntarily wiped chocolate syrup from his sleeve, like the pumpkin thief feeling his shoulder.

meaning: Someone helps outsiders but neglects their own family.
english: Someone helps outsiders but neglects their own family.
example: Spending lavishly to sponsor the village cricket tournament while his own aged mother starved without medication, the hypocrite was mocked as a plague at home and an angel to the town.

meaning: Private struggles are not always visible.
english: Private struggles are not always visible.
example: Dressed in crisp silks for the temple festival, the quiet family hid the agony of their daughter's prolonged hospital illness, for inner domestic turmoil rarely shows outside.

meaning: Kind words can bring people together.
english: Kind words can bring people together.
example: A gentle, respectful conversation initiated by the grandmother over morning coffee smoothed months of silence between the sisters-in-law, uniting a fractured household.

meaning: The advice of elders deserves attention.
english: The advice of elders deserves attention.
example: Listening carefully to the retired blacksmith's technique for tempering iron saved the apprentice years of trial and error, proving elder counsel rings like a pure brass bell.

meaning: Children are the pride of a family.
english: Children are the pride of a family.
example: Running barefoot across the veranda with joyous laughter, the twin toddlers brought light and warmth into their grandparents' quiet house, serving as the true eyes of the home.

meaning: Family is the first place we learn values.
english: Family is the first place we learn values.
example: Long before he stepped into a formal classroom, the boy learned honesty and compassion from his grandmother's bedtime stories, showing that home is the foundational school.

meaning: A mother's love is incomparable.
english: A mother is an irreplaceable treasure.
example: After eating lavish banquets across foreign hotels, the homesick student craved his mother's simple rasam, affirming that there is no kin like a mother and no flavor like salt.

gaade: ಮನೆ ನೋಡಿ ಮಗಳು ಕೊಡು, ಬೆಳೆ ನೋಡಿ ಹೊಲ ಕೊಡು.
meaning: Examine carefully before making an important decision.
english: Examine carefully before making an important decision.
example: Checking the bridegroom's family reputation and the soil quality before leasing the farm, the cautious elder advised inspecting the household before giving one's daughter.

meaning: People in one family can have many opinions.
english: People in one family can have many opinions.
example: Though living under one tiled roof, the four brothers held wildly different ambitions, showing that one house can hold a hundred distinct minds.

meaning: A mother's presence gives a sense of belonging.
english: A mother's presence gives a sense of belonging.
example: Visiting the ancestral village felt warm and welcoming only so long as the elderly matriarch sat on the porch, for where a mother lives, the maternal sanctuary endures.

meaning: A person's good qualities benefit their family.
english: A person's good qualities benefit their family.
example: With her gentle speech, selfless service, and integrity, the elder daughter brought honor and peace to both families, like a sacred lamp illuminating the entire home.

meaning: Unity makes a home peaceful.
english: United we stand, divided we fall.
example: Putting aside petty grievances and celebrating festivals together turned their cramped dwelling into a heaven, confirming that unity makes any home celestial.

meaning: Winning an argument is not worth losing a friendship.
english: Winning an argument is not worth losing a friendship.
example: Rather than humiliating his childhood buddy to win a heated debate on cricket statistics, Vinay conceded gracefully, knowing that preserving friendship matters more than winning an argument.

meaning: Private disputes can become public gossip.
english: Private disputes can become public gossip.
example: What began as a petty dispute over parking space between two brothers ended up being broadcast across the entire colony, proving that domestic quarrels soon become public spectacles.

meaning: A mother's care is precious.
english: A mother's care is precious.
example: Seeking solace after a bruising corporate career, the tired man sat beside his elderly mother and rested his head in her lap, finding the purest temple on earth.

meaning: Togetherness makes people stronger.
english: Togetherness makes people stronger.
example: When the neighborhood shopkeepers banded together against the local extortion gang, the troublemakers fled, proving that collective unity multiplies human strength.

gaade: ಪರರ ಕಣ್ಣಿನ ಹುಲ್ಲು ಕಾಣುತ್ತದೆ, ತನ್ನ ಕಣ್ಣಿನ ಮರ ಕಾಣುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.
meaning: People notice others faults but ignore their own.
english: People notice others faults but ignore their own.
example: Loudly condemning his colleague for taking a ten-minute tea break while ignoring his own hours of online shopping, the supervisor saw the grass blade in another's eye but missed the log in his own.

meaning: People often fail to recognise their own mistakes.
english: People often fail to recognise their own mistakes.
example: Quick to point out spelling typos in other students' assignments, the arrogant boy never noticed his own total lack of mathematical logic, blind to his personal shortcomings.

meaning: Anger can cause irreversible damage.
english: Wrath has no place in reconciliation.
example: Throwing his laptop against the brick wall in a blinding flash of fury left him with broken equipment and a cancelled contract, learning that a nose cut in anger cannot be restored in peace.

gaade: ಮಾತು ಮನೆ ಕೆಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ತೂತು ಒಲೆ ಕೆಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
meaning: Careless words can damage relationships.
english: Careless words can damage relationships.
example: A single reckless insult hurled during the wedding luncheon divided two branches of the family for thirty years, proving that careless words destroy homes just as leaks ruin stoves.

meaning: Solve a problem without unnecessary damage.
english: Kill two birds with one stone.
example: Negotiating a peaceful land settlement where neither farmer lost acreage nor took the dispute to court, the village headman resolved the issue so the snake died without breaking the stick.

meaning: Kind words strengthen relationships.
english: Kind words strengthen relationships.
example: Offering a polite greeting and listening patiently to the frustrated tenant transformed an angry confrontation into a warm mutual agreement, proving that kind words build lasting bonds.

meaning: Family unity is a source of strength.
english: Family unity is a source of strength.
example: Though external rivals attempted to undercut their family business, the three sisters stood shoulder-to-shoulder, showing that internal unity is the greatest fortress.

meaning: Mutual support makes life easier.
english: Mutual support makes life easier.
example: Taking turns watching each other's cattle and sharing agricultural tractors during harvest season made life manageable and sweet for the dryland farmers.

meaning: Self interest should not spoil friendship.
english: Self interest should not spoil friendship.
example: Demanding a commission before recommending his closest friend for an open job opening poisoned their decades of brotherhood, proving that selfish greed must never intrude upon friendship.

meaning: Trust helps relationships survive.
english: Trust helps relationships survive.
example: By returning the borrowed gold ornaments promptly on the promised morning without a scratch, Sunita preserved the priceless trust that held her extended family together.

meaning: A good neighbour can be like family.
english: A good neighbour can be like family.
example: When his wife suddenly went into labor at midnight during a downpour, it was the next-door neighbor who drove them to the clinic, proving a good neighbor is better than distant kin.

meaning: Patience is a bridge between people.
english: Patience is a bridge between people.
example: Instead of retaliating against his roommate's annoying habits, Praveen addressed the matter gently over dinner, using patience as a sturdy bridge across differences.

meaning: Affection can achieve what force cannot.
english: Affection can achieve what force cannot.
example: Winning the stubborn stray dog's trust with a bowl of warm rice achieved in five minutes what shouting and brandishing sticks could never accomplish.

meaning: A person's words reveal their character.
english: A person's words reveal their character.
example: Though he wore tailored suits and gold watches, the man's arrogant dismissals of the canteen waiter revealed his true, uncultured character.

meaning: Mutual respect is the basis of relationships.
english: Mutual respect is the basis of relationships.
example: Greeting both the senior director and the office janitor with identical warmth, the young executive established that mutual respect forms the bedrock of all human ties.

meaning: The person who stands by you in hardship is truly close.
english: The person who stands by you in hardship is truly close.
example: Sitting beside him in the hospital waiting room through the bleakest hours of the night, Chetan showed that the one who stands with you in grief is your genuine companion.

meaning: A promise should be kept.
english: A promise should be kept.
example: Honoring his verbal commitment to deliver the handloom sarees despite raw silk prices doubling overnight, the honest weaver proved that a pledged word must always be kept.

meaning: A person rich in family affection is truly wealthy.
english: A person rich in family affection is truly wealthy.
example: He possessed neither vast real estate nor offshore shares, yet surrounded by loving grandchildren and loyal neighbors, the retired teacher lived as the richest man in the town.

meaning: People should understand one another's pain.
english: People should understand one another's pain.
example: Stepping quietly to cover the night shift for a tired colleague whose child had a high fever, the nurse showed that true humanity lies in understanding another's pain.

meaning: Blaming circumstances for one's own inability.
english: A bad workman blames his tools.
example: Failing her dance audition and immediately complaining that the stage wooden floor was tilted, the conceited girl illustrated the inept dancer blaming the uneven ground.

meaning: Explaining something to someone unwilling or unable to understand.
english: Casting pearls before swine.
example: Trying to explain quantum cryptography to an uncle who insisted smartphones are possessed by spirits felt like playing a divine lute before a buffalo.

meaning: Giving something valuable to someone who cannot appreciate it.
english: Giving something valuable to someone who cannot appreciate it.
example: Handing an antique leather-bound Sanskrit manuscript to an unruly toddler who used it as coloring scrap was truly giving a priceless ruby into a monkey's paw.

meaning: A person without appreciation cannot recognise quality.
english: Do not throw pearls to swine.
example: Throwing gourmet artisanal French cheese to an unruly street hound that preferred discarded bone scraps showed that a donkey has no appreciation for the fragrance of musk.

meaning: Something is useless to a person who cannot benefit from it.
english: Something is useless to a person who cannot benefit from it.
example: Offering a pair of high-powered binoculars to someone who refused to open his eyes was as meaningless as holding up a mirror before a blind man.

meaning: Speaking unnecessarily can expose one's ignorance.
english: Speaking unnecessarily can expose one's ignorance.
example: Remaining silent would have kept everyone assuming he was an expert, but the moment he opened his mouth and misquoted basic geography, his ignorance was on display.

meaning: Half knowledge is dangerous.
english: A little learning is a dangerous thing.
example: After reading two unverified health blog posts, the amateur self-prescribed heavy antibiotics and ended up in the emergency ward, proving half-baked knowledge is perilous.

meaning: Ask when unsure guide when knowledgeable.
english: Ask when unsure guide when knowledgeable.
example: When unsure about operating the high-voltage lathe, the apprentice asked the senior mechanic, respecting the rule that the uninformed must ask and the knowledgeable must guide.

meaning: Excessive talking can create problems.
english: Excessive talking can create problems.
example: Endlessly gossiping about everyone's private affairs at the residential society meeting created bitter factions, proving that excess chatter ruins peaceful homes.

gaade: ನಾಲಿಗೆಗೆ ಮೂಳೆ ಇಲ್ಲ, ಆಡಿದ ಮಾತಿಗೆ ಬೆಲೆ ಇದೆ.
meaning: Words have consequences.
english: Words have consequences.
example: Though the tongue has no bone of its own, the cruel remarks it utters can shatter the strongest bones and spirits; words carry weight and consequence.

meaning: Making an already bad situation worse.
english: Making an already bad situation worse.
example: Bringing up ancient property rivalries in the middle of a delicate wedding negotiation was like pouring pure ghee directly into a raging campfire.

meaning: One lie often leads to many more.
english: One lie leads to another.
example: Falsifying his first test score forced the student to invent a fake sickness, forge a doctor's slip, and dodge phone calls, demonstrating that one lie demands a hundred more.

meaning: Advice is wasted on someone unwilling to listen.
english: Advice is wasted on someone unwilling to listen.
example: Giving sensible financial advice to a spendthrift who ignored every warning was as fruitless as blowing a sacred conch into a brass ear.

meaning: Speak less and work more.
english: Speech is silver, silence is golden.
example: While other candidates posted theatrical campaign videos online, the quiet social worker repaired three village wells, living the maxim of speaking less and doing more.

meaning: Let your words be thoughtful and respectful.
english: Let your words be thoughtful and respectful.
example: Weighing each sentence before addressing the agitated crowd, the elder spoke with gentle grace, ensuring his words fell like soothing pearls.

meaning: Careless speech can cause serious trouble.
english: Careless speech can cause serious trouble.
example: An uncontrolled urge to share confidential company gossip over drinks cost the senior manager his prestigious career, proving loose lips ruin lives.

meaning: A guilty person is often suspicious.
english: A guilty mind is always suspicious.
example: Every time the police cruiser passed through the market lane, the shopkeeper who kept stolen watches nervously twitched his collar, displaying a thief's restless mind.

meaning: A dishonest person always finds an excuse.
english: A dishonest person always finds an excuse.
example: Whenever called upon to help clean the neighborhood drainage ditch, the chronic shirker had a convenient headache, showing a dishonest person always finds an excuse.

meaning: One irresponsible person can spoil things for everyone.
english: One irresponsible person can spoil things for everyone.
example: By recklessly vandalizing the shared community water pipeline after his personal connection was cut, the disgruntled youth ruined the entire orchard for everyone.

meaning: Without understanding a person cannot appreciate their surroundings.
english: Without understanding a person cannot appreciate their surroundings.
example: Placing an uncultivated, boorish fellow in a regal palace surrounded by classical art brings no joy to him; to an ignorant mind, even a palace feels like an alien forest.

meaning: A person may fail to see their own shortcomings.
english: A person may fail to see their own shortcomings.
example: Quick to lecture his colleagues on punctuality, the supervisor never realized he spent two hours daily playing games, incapable of inspecting his own back.

meaning: A clever person may simply make the best of a foolish situation.
english: A clever person may simply make the best of a foolish situation.
example: When chaos and yelling broke out during the disorganized society meeting, the pragmatic member quietly helped himself to the buffet samosas and walked away satisfied.

meaning: Silence can be the best response in some arguments.
english: Silence can be the best response in some arguments.
example: When his in-laws began trading angry accusations over festival gifts, Srinivas folded his hands and held his peace, knowing silence is the only remedy in a house of noise.

meaning: Judge actions not promises.
english: Judge actions not promises.
example: Do not be swayed by the smooth-talking salesman's grand promises of instant wealth; examine the actual product performance and value concrete deeds.

meaning: Do not judge people by appearances.
english: Do not judge people by appearances.
example: Deceived by the fraudster's aristocratic attire and charming smile, the investor handed over his money, regretting judging character solely by outward appearance.

meaning: Not everything is as it appears.
english: Appearances are deceptive.
example: The glitzy showroom looked prosperous from the highway, but closer inspection revealed massive unpaid supplier debts, proving not everything visible to the eye is true.

meaning: All that glitters is not gold.
english: All that glitters is not gold.
example: The gold-plated wrist watch bought from the pavement vendor tarnished into dull green copper within three days, reminding the buyer that all that glitters is not gold.

meaning: Something may look valuable but be hollow inside.
english: A wolf in sheep’s clothing.
example: Beneath the polished marble facade and velvet couches of the coaching academy lay incompetent tutors and outdated notes, golden on the outside but stone within.

meaning: Those with little substance may make the most noise.
english: Empty vessels make the loudest noise.
example: The noisy politician who shouted the loudest during the rally had never sponsored a single development project, acting like an empty vessel that clatters loudest.

meaning: Pride can lead to downfall.
english: Pride can lead to downfall.
example: Boasting that his tech startup was invincible and mocking his competitors, the arrogant CEO went bankrupt within two quarters, proving pride precedes downfall.

meaning: Giving power to someone who cannot use it responsibly.
english: Giving power to someone who cannot use it responsibly.
example: Appointing an impulsive, vindictive teenager as the group administrator resulted in half the members being blocked in anger, like handing a sharp blade to a monkey.

meaning: A person without understanding may not appreciate something important.
english: A person without understanding may not appreciate something important.
example: To someone who has never appreciated architecture, the historic temple tower appears as nothing more than a pile of carved granite blocks.

gaade: ಕೇಳುವ ಕಿವಿ ಇದ್ದರೆ ಹೇಳುವ ಬಾಯಿ ಇರುತ್ತದೆ.
meaning: A willing learner can find someone to teach them.
english: A willing learner can find someone to teach them.
example: When the young apprentice showed genuine curiosity and eagerness to learn, the master woodcarver gladly revealed his secret carving techniques, for a listening ear finds a speaking mouth.

meaning: Losing trust can mean losing everything.
english: Losing trust can mean losing everything.
example: Once his embezzlement was exposed to his business partners, no amount of collateral could restore his credit, for losing trust is losing everything.

gaade: ಹುಲಿ ಬಂತು ಹುಲಿ ಎಂದರೆ ಯಾರೂ ನಂಬುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.
meaning: Repeated false alarms destroy credibility.
english: Cry wolf.
example: After pulling three fake panic alarms just to watch the staff scramble, the boy found no one responding when a real kitchen grease fire erupted, like the boy who cried wolf.

meaning: A guilty person struggles to remain calm.
english: A guilty person struggles to remain calm.
example: Waiting nervously for the auditor's report, the corrupt clerk couldn't sit still and kept pacing the corridor, for a thief's feet can never rest steady on the ground.

gaade: ಒಂದು ಹನಿ ವಿಷ ಇಡೀ ಹಾಲನ್ನು ಕೆಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
meaning: One harmful element can spoil something good.
english: One harmful element can spoil something good.
example: A single vulgar comment posted on the company's official forum tarnished months of good marketing, showing that one drop of poison spoils a cauldron of milk.

meaning: A bad experience can make someone cautious.
english: A bad experience can make someone cautious.
example: Having suffered severe food poisoning from street mayonnaise last monsoon, the girl became cautious of even eating a plain cold salad, like a scalded kitten fearing every cat.

meaning: Trust matters though it should be thoughtful.
english: Trust matters though it should be thoughtful.
example: While reckless gullibility is foolish, closing one's heart to all human trust leaves a person utterly isolated; genuine faith is essential for a meaningful life.

meaning: Truth endures.
english: Truth endures.
example: Though powerful enemies attempted to bury the truth under fabricated police reports, the innocent man was finally exonerated, proving truth never dies.

meaning: Truth ultimately prevails.
english: Truth will out.
example: Despite enduring years of legal hurdles and intimidation, the whistleblowing engineer stood firm until the bridge contractor was prosecuted, confirming truth ultimately triumphs.

meaning: A person's words reflect their character.
english: A person's words reflect their character.
example: Listening to the candidate treat his campaign staff with genuine courtesy convinced the voters of his noble character, for words are the mirror of the human heart.

meaning: Admitting a mistake is a strength.
english: Admitting a mistake is a strength.
example: When his calculation error caused a system crash, the senior developer stood up in the meeting and took full responsibility, showing that admitting a mistake is true greatness.

meaning: A wise person learns from experience.
english: A wise person learns from experience.
example: Having once lost his down payment to an unregistered real estate builder, the wise buyer thoroughly inspected municipal approvals the second time, learning from experience.

meaning: A person who makes a mistake should correct it.
english: A person who makes a mistake should correct it.
example: Instead of inventing defensive excuses for the botched presentation, the young intern redrafted the slides and asked for feedback, demonstrating that mistakes should be rectified.

meaning: Experience is a great teacher.
english: Experience is the best teacher.
example: No university lecture could teach him the unpredictable nature of agricultural seasons as thoroughly as three decades of farming his own land, for experience is the greatest guru.

meaning: Money has great influence in society.
english: Money makes the mare go.
example: Watching the town councilors rush to greet the wealthy liquor baron while ignoring the retired school headmaster showed that in this mundane world, money remains king.

meaning: Do not borrow to maintain a luxurious lifestyle.
english: Live within your means.
example: Taking on massive high-interest credit card debt just to dine at five-star rooftop lounges is the height of folly; never borrow money to eat clarified butter.

meaning: Money can make ordinary things seem luxurious.
english: Money can make ordinary things seem luxurious.
example: When a man has millions in his bank account, even sleeping on a simple coarse blanket is praised by flatterers as profound philosophical simplicity.

meaning: Money can influence even unlikely people.
english: Money can influence even unlikely people.
example: Seeing how quickly bureaucratic obstacles melted away once the builder handed over grease money, the onlookers remarked that cash makes even a corpse open its jaws.

meaning: Showing off without having the means.
english: Showing off without having the means.
example: Carrying an empty wallet while swaggering through the bazaar and bragging about ancestral estates made the foolish youth an object of town ridicule.

meaning: No basic necessities but unnecessary luxury.
english: No basic necessities but unnecessary luxury.
example: Wearing imported designer sunglasses while his younger siblings begged for basic school fees illustrated having no grain in the belly but jasmine flowers in the hair.

meaning: Wanting rewards without wanting to work.
english: Wanting rewards without wanting to work.
example: The lazy student expected an A-grade on the group project without contributing a single paragraph of research, craving the feast while detesting the labor.

meaning: Money can solve many practical difficulties.
english: Money can solve many practical difficulties.
example: With sufficient emergency savings tucked away in fixed deposits, the family handled the sudden hospital surgery smoothly, proving that having money softens many blows.

meaning: Sometimes the giver is taken for granted while the receiver benefits.
english: Sometimes the giver is taken for granted while the receiver benefits.
example: The kind man who lent money was treated like a fool while the shameless borrower lived extravagantly and refused to repay, turning the lender into a clown.

gaade: ಅಡಕೆಗೆ ಹೋದ ಮಾನ ಆನೆ ಕೊಟ್ಟರೂ ಬಾರದು.
meaning: Lost respect is difficult to regain.
english: Lost respect is difficult to regain.
example: Stealing a handful of betel nuts ruined the merchant's thirty years of honesty in the village market, proving that respect lost over a trifle cannot be bought back with an elephant.

gaade: ಕಳ್ಳನಿಗೆ ಒಂದು ದಿನ, ಸತ್ಯವಂತನಿಗೆ ನೂರು ದಿನ.
meaning: Dishonesty may last briefly truth has longer life.
english: Dishonesty may last briefly truth has longer life.
example: The deceitful trader made quick profits for a month before his warehouse was raided, whereas the honest merchant across the street prospered for fifty years.

meaning: Deception eventually brings consequences.
english: Deception eventually brings consequences.
example: The con artist who tricked elderly pensioners with fraudulent land deeds was eventually swindled of all his ill-gotten wealth by his own business partner.

meaning: Everyone must face the consequences of their actions.
english: Everyone must face the consequences of their actions.
example: When the corrupt inspector was finally suspended from duty and faced judicial inquiry, nobody was surprised, knowing that whoever eats salt must drink water.

meaning: There is often a reason behind a sign or rumour.
english: There is often a reason behind a sign or rumour.
example: Though the company spokesperson denied any takeover rumors, the presence of five international auditors in the conference room showed there is no smoke without fire.

meaning: An honest person has less reason to fear exposure.
english: An honest person has less reason to fear exposure.
example: Knowing his books were clean, the honest accountant welcomed the government audit with a relaxed smile, for truth bestows courage while dishonesty breeds terror.

meaning: Act according to your means.
english: Act according to your means.
example: Matching his family's modest holiday trip to their actual monthly savings prevented any debt, exemplifying tying anklets that match the size of one's ankles.

meaning: Celebrating before the event actually happens.
english: Celebrating before the event actually happens.
example: Booking a victory party banquet two weeks before the election ballots were even cast made the overconfident politician a laughingstock when results were announced.

meaning: Something was lost just before it could be enjoyed.
english: Something was lost just before it could be enjoyed.
example: Just as the student reached out to sign the scholarship acceptance papers, the funding council announced an indefinite budget freeze, losing the morsel before it reached the mouth.

meaning: Helping someone who may not appreciate or repay it.
english: Helping someone who may not appreciate or repay it.
example: Bailing out the ungrateful relative who immediately badmouthed him behind his back felt exactly like pouring warm milk down a venomous serpent's throat.

meaning: One person's fun can be another person's suffering.
english: What is fun to the cat is death to the mouse.
example: While the wealthy landlord sat on his veranda laughing at the dog chasing the stray goat, the impoverished goat owner wept over his livelihood, showing one's sport is another's agony.

meaning: Money can change people's behaviour.
english: Money can change people's behaviour.
example: Seeing the stone-faced clerk suddenly smile and process the file within minutes of seeing the envelope proved that money makes even corpses speak.

meaning: A powerful or influential person often sets the path for others.
english: Might is right.
example: When the veteran industrialist launched his new venture, smaller suppliers and investors immediately followed his footsteps, for wherever the mighty elephant walks, a path is made.

meaning: Everyone gets their turn circumstances change.
english: Every dog has its day.
example: The senior clerk who was once bullied by his manager became a gentle, supportive supervisor himself, knowing that every mother-in-law has her day and every daughter-in-law has hers.

meaning: Two events happening together does not prove that one caused the other.
english: Correlation is not causation.
example: The sudden power blackout happening right as the cat jumped on the fence was pure coincidence; a crow perching on a bough does not prove it snapped the timber.

meaning: Something obvious does not need further proof.
english: What need is there of a mirror to see the obvious?
example: When the stolen laptop was found right inside the suspect's backpack, there was no need for further investigation, for why hold a mirror to view a blister on one's own palm?

meaning: Those who express their needs are more likely to receive help.
english: The squeaky wheel gets the grease.
example: Speaking up clearly about her unfair workload during the annual review got her assigned two assistants, proving that only the crying child receives milk.

gaade: ಊಟ ಬಲ್ಲವನಿಗೆ ರೋಗವಿಲ್ಲ, ಮಾತು ಬಲ್ಲವನಿಗೆ ಜಗಳವಿಲ್ಲ.
meaning: Wise eating and thoughtful speaking can prevent problems.
english: Eat well to live well; speak well to live in peace.
example: Eating balanced home-cooked meals kept the old farmer free of illness, while speaking gently kept him free of lawsuits, proving mindful diet and speech prevent trouble.

meaning: Skill and capability earn respect and responsibility.
english: A capable cook rules the house.
example: Managing the kitchen and family pantry with exceptional thrift and culinary flair made the young bride the respected mistress of the entire household.

meaning: An authoritative decision is treated as final.
english: The king’s command is etched in stone.
example: Once the Supreme Court issued its final verdict on the river water dispute, both states had to comply, for an authoritative decree is etched in granite.

meaning: Education is lasting wealth.
english: Education is lasting wealth.
example: Though thieves could rob his cattle and fire could destroy his barn, the scholar's deep knowledge remained untouched, proving education is the only imperishable wealth.

meaning: Knowledge gained through learning stays with you.
english: Knowledge gained through learning stays with you.
example: Even after losing his job during the economic downturn, the skilled carpenter started a custom furniture business and thrived, for learning acquired never abandons the hand.

meaning: A good teacher guides a student towards success.
english: A good teacher guides a student towards success.
example: Following the rigorous problem-solving approach taught by his high school mathematics mentor helped the scientist solve complex rocket equations, guided by his teacher's path.

meaning: Reading and learning enlighten life.
english: Reading and learning enlighten life.
example: Spending quiet evenings immersed in classic literature illuminated the young girl's mind, proving the friendship of books brings true light to human life.

meaning: Humility is the true ornament of education.
english: Humility is the true ornament of education.
example: Despite holding two doctorates from world-renowned universities, Dr. Rao spoke humbly to every hospital orderly, illustrating that humility is the supreme ornament of education.

gaade: ಉಳುಮೆ ಮಾಡಿದ ಭೂಮಿ ಎಂದಿಗೂ ಕೈ ಬಿಡದು.
meaning: Hard work in farming brings rewards.
english: Hard work in farming brings rewards.
example: Working the rich black soil with compost and diligent weeding rewarded the farmer with towering maize stalks, showing that land tilled with devotion never betrays.

gaade: ಬಿತ್ತುವ ಕಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಮಲಗಿದರೆ ಕೊಯ್ಯುವ ಕಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಳಬೇಕು.
meaning: Neglecting work at the right time brings regret later.
english: Neglecting work at the right time brings regret later.
example: Sleeping under the cool shade of the banyan tree during the crucial monsoon sowing weeks left the lazy farmer weeping before an empty barn during harvest time.

meaning: Understanding the land is important for farming.
english: Understanding the land is important for farming.
example: Testing the soil moisture and adjusting crop rotation according to the land's texture proved that understanding the earth is the hallmark of a master farmer.

meaning: Agriculture provides the foundation for life.
english: Agriculture provides the foundation for life.
example: Whatever technological revolutions sweep through our cities, agriculture remains the indispensable backbone sustaining all human existence.

meaning: The value of land is understood through its produce.
english: The value of land is understood through its produce.
example: A barren, neglected acre gains true value only when green shoots of ragi push through the dark soil, for land's true worth is proven through its harvest.

meaning: Protecting trees helps protect rainfall and nature.
english: Protecting trees helps protect rainfall and nature.
example: By planting two hundred native banyan and tamarind saplings along the canal bunds, the village retained its groundwater, knowing trees preserve rain.

meaning: Greenery supports life.
english: Where there is green, there is life.
example: Protecting the sprawling forest canopy around the valley ensured clean mountain springs and fresh air, proving that where greenery thrives, life breathes.

meaning: Water is the foundation of life.
english: Water is the foundation of life.
example: Conserving every droplet of rain in recharge wells sustained the arid community through summer, honoring water as the very foundation of life.

meaning: Protecting nature protects us.
english: Protecting nature protects us.
example: Desilting the ancient riverbanks and refusing to dump plastic into the stream protected the valley from flash floods, showing nature protects those who protect her.

meaning: A well maintained water source benefits the entire village.
english: A well maintained water source benefits the entire village.
example: When the rejuvenated village lake brimmed with crystal water after the rains, both the agricultural wells and the cattle thrived, blessing the entire community.

meaning: Health is true wealth.
english: Health is wealth.
example: Recovering from severe burnout taught the corporate executive to prioritize sleep and daily exercise, realizing that good health is the greatest wealth.

meaning: Eating in moderation supports good health.
english: Eating in moderation supports good health.
example: Eating half a belly of fresh food and drinking warm water kept the grandmother energetic at eighty, demonstrating that measured eating is the secret of vitality.

meaning: Eating sensibly helps maintain a healthy life.
english: Eating sensibly helps maintain a healthy life.
example: Avoiding overly oily, processed snacks and dining with mindfulness allowed the professor to maintain vibrant health and peace of mind.

meaning: Moderate eating is beneficial.
english: Moderate eating is beneficial.
example: Eating modest, wholesome portions and leaving the dinner table lightly satisfied treats food as divine nectar rather than a burden on the stomach.

meaning: Cleanliness is the first step towards health.
english: Cleanliness is the first step towards health.
example: Washing hands thoroughly and keeping the water storage vessels covered prevented all seasonal fevers in the school, proving cleanliness is the first step to health.

meaning: Trust is the foundation of business.
english: Trust is the foundation of business.
example: By always replacing defective goods without arguing and keeping his prices fair, the fabric merchant built an empire of trust, the true capital of trade.

meaning: Business without proper accounting leads to losses.
english: Business without proper accounting leads to losses.
example: Failing to maintain a daily ledger of shop expenses and credit sales led the grocery store into sudden bankruptcy, proving accounting is vital to commerce.

meaning: Customers are essential to a business.
english: The customer is king.
example: Greeting even the most demanding shopper with patience and a welcoming smile, the shopkeeper prospered, honoring the customer as the deity of commerce.

meaning: Small profits can build long term success.
english: Small profits can build long term success.
example: Instead of chasing speculative windfalls, the bakery owner banked steady small profits each month, slowly building a chain of three successful outlets.

meaning: Money earned through effort is valuable.
english: Money earned through effort is valuable.
example: A single rupee earned by honest sweat carries greater peace of mind and dignity than thousands acquired through deceit or inheritance.

meaning: The welfare of the community benefits everyone.
english: The welfare of the community benefits everyone.
example: When the youth volunteered to repair the damaged municipal culvert, the whole village prospered, proving the community's welfare is everyone's welfare.

meaning: Helping others is a noble deed.
english: Helping others is a noble deed.
example: Distributing warm blankets and hot porridge to stranded migrants during the cold winter night was a noble act of selfless compassion.

meaning: Good neighbours are a valuable asset.
english: Good neighbours are a valuable asset.
example: Living beside considerate neighbors who checked on her elderly parents every afternoon gave the working doctor tremendous peace of mind, a true life asset.

meaning: Cooperation is necessary for social life.
english: Cooperation is necessary for social life.
example: No single family could build the village grain storage unit alone; it was mutual cooperation and shared labor that made communal life thrive.

meaning: Sharing increases happiness.
english: Sharing increases happiness.
example: Sharing the bowl of sweet payasa with the neighboring children brought ten times more happiness than eating the entire pot alone.

meaning: A leader's qualities strengthen the team.
english: A leader's qualities strengthen the team.
example: By leading with composure, empathy, and clear instructions during the crisis, the captain inspired his team to victory, proving leadership shapes team strength.

meaning: A leader must show direction.
english: A leader must show direction.
example: Taking the first step into the flooded road to guide the trapped bus passengers to safety, the local youth showed that whoever claims leadership must demonstrate the way.

meaning: Responsibility is greater than authority.
english: Responsibility is greater than authority.
example: Sitting in the magistrate's chair, the judge remembered that the power to punish is secondary to the grave responsibility to dispense impartial justice.

meaning: Justice creates trust.
english: Justice creates trust.
example: Resolving boundary disputes fairly without taking bribes or favoring relatives earned the village elders enduring respect and community trust.

meaning: Good administration benefits the people.
english: Good administration benefits the people.
example: Transparent municipal accounting, paved roads, and prompt drinking water supply brought prosperity to the district, proving good administration is a people's blessing.

meaning: Courage helps find a way forward.
english: Courage helps find a way forward.
example: Confronting his stutter and stepping onto the debate podium with a steady heart, the young student discovered that courage illuminates the darkest path.

meaning: Fear can prevent people from taking opportunities.
english: Fear can prevent people from taking opportunities.
example: Paralyzed by the fear of being rejected, the timid applicant never submitted his proposal, proving that those who fear can never seize opportunities.

meaning: Challenges are steps towards achievement.
english: Challenges are steps towards achievement.
example: Viewing his business bankruptcy not as a final defeat but as a priceless lesson, the entrepreneur built a resilient logistics firm, using challenges as stepping stones.

meaning: Failure teaches us how to recover.
english: Failure teaches us how to recover.
example: After tumbling off the bicycle five times and scraping his knees, the boy got back on the pedals and mastered balance, for only he who falls learns to rise.

meaning: A determined person does not give up.
english: A determined person does not give up.
example: Refusing to despair even when his field trial failed three times, the agricultural scientist pressed on until his drought-resistant seed variety flourished.

meaning: Good values are a person's true ornament.
english: Good values are a person's true ornament.
example: No diamond necklace or silk attire could match the dignity radiated by the modest teacher who treated every human being with gentle courtesy and noble values.

meaning: Preserving language helps preserve culture.
english: Preserving language helps preserve culture.
example: Teaching his children to read, speak, and write beautiful Kannada while living in Chicago preserved their cultural heritage across generations.

meaning: Elders experience guides younger generations.
english: Elders experience guides younger generations.
example: Consulting his eighty-year-old grandfather before laying the foundation for the ancestral house saved the young architect from digging into underground springs.

meaning: Traditions are rooted in culture.
english: Traditions are rooted in culture.
example: Lighting brass lamps at dusk and singing devotional vachanas connected the modern family to centuries of living tradition, rooted deep in culture.

meaning: One's mother tongue has a unique beauty.
english: One's mother tongue has a unique beauty.
example: No foreign poetry could evoke the raw emotional resonance and sweetness that a simple lullaby sung in one's mother tongue stirs in the heart.

meaning: Discipline leads to success.
english: Discipline leads to success.
example: Waking up at five each morning for disciplined music practice enabled the violinist to master difficult ragas, confirming discipline breeds excellence.

meaning: Punctuality is the first step towards achievement.
english: Punctuality is the first step towards achievement.
example: Arriving ten minutes before the scheduled interview impressed the board before a single question was asked, showing punctuality is the first step to achievement.

meaning: Handling small responsibilities builds trust.
english: Handling small responsibilities builds trust.
example: Carefully verifying and delivering the small daily postal parcel built the courier's reputation, showing handling small tasks reliably earns profound trust.

meaning: Following rules helps maintain peace.
english: Following rules helps maintain peace.
example: Following traffic regulations and wearing a helmet kept the commuter safe throughout years of chaotic city transit, proving rules safeguard peace.

meaning: Today's responsibilities should be completed today.
english: Today's responsibilities should be completed today.
example: Instead of leaving the leaky tap repair for the weekend, the prudent homeowner tightened the washer immediately, completing today's duty today.

meaning: Starting preparation only after calamity has already arrived is futile.
english: Digging a well after the house catches fire.
example: Scrambling to purchase emergency water storage drums only after the municipal borewell had run completely dry felt like digging a well after the house caught fire.

meaning: Every household has its own private flaws, troubles, or secrets.
english: Every family has its skeleton in the closet.
example: Hearing her neighbor lament about domestic quarrels, Sunita smiled gently and comforted her, reminding her that every house's dosa has its hidden holes.
